The Office of the Registrar is charged with being the official academic record-keeper of the College. Using the principles of Performance (providing excellent customer service to all constituencies on a continuous basis), Integrity (conducting business in a professional manner by abiding by the rules, regulations, policies, and procedures set forth by the University, the College, and outside regulatory agencies), Innovation (using all facets of currently available technology and continually searching for new, pioneering, and additional methods to accurately record, store, and distribute academic records), and Partnership (working as a cohesive team within the office, the Enrollment Management division, and campuswide to aid in facilitating the college’s strategic plans), we will uphold the mission of the office.
